name: Brutalist Concrete
description: Post-war Brutalist architecture photography: monolithic polished concrete, hard geometric shadows, stark monochrome austerity.
magic_media_keywords: Post-war Brutalist architecture photography, monolithic polished concrete and raw board-formed concrete surfaces, hard directional midday sun casting sharp geometric shadows, architectural wide-angle register, stark monochrome austerity with a single muted accent, one vast blank concrete wall held as negative space for typography.
palette_hint: béton brut — concrete gray (#8C8C88) with a muted rust accent (#C7521E), anchored by chalk white (#EDEDEA) and near-black (#1B1B1B) for legible contrast
best_for: architecture portfolios, industrial-design showcases, and raw urban streetwear with monolithic concrete severity
